info.name: Blog Management API
info.description:
REST API for a Blog app with Admin, User and Guest access levels.

Just import and run the whole collection (Runner). Every run registers fresh users, so it can be repeated.
Only one-time setup: create the Postman admin with
  ADMIN_EMAIL=postman.admin@example.com ADMIN_PASSWORD=Admin@12345 npm run seed:admin
(or change the adminEmail / adminPassword collection variables to an existing admin).

exec: pm.test('Role is user and account is active', () => { pm.expect(res.user.role).to.eql('user'); pm.expect(res.user.isActive).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Creates a brand-new user for this run (unique email), so the collection can be re-run any number of times.
Needs a seeded admin: npm run seed:admin (see the collection description).
Always answers with the same generic message. A reset link (valid for 1 hour, single use) is emailed, or printed in the server console when SMTP is not configured.
Must look identical to 2c so the endpoint cannot be used to discover registered emails.
